title: fix(objectql): a refused first install leaves nothing of itself, even over a tenant's object
body:
domain:server#2 · os-project-manager · session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XJn3tHAnFh4h1yjpiKahdTG)_

Refs #28697

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：首次安装一个包时，如果注册表在注册过程中拒绝了它，这个包不会留下任何东西，包括它叠在租户已有对象（及租户的覆盖层）、无主覆盖层或别的包的扩展之上的情况；原来在那里的内容和尝试之前读起来完全一样。
- **为什么改**：被拒的安装应当让系统保持原样，运维修好包再装即可。拒绝本身（错误码、状态、文字）不变。
- **风险与回滚**：objectql patch。所有 `registerApp` 现在都经过注册表已有的"被拒即放回"（升级已经在用的那一套），首次安装不再走卸载式撤回；干净的安装、升级和运维卸载行为不变，禁用状态的启动种子照旧保留。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 的 `registerApp`（一处调用替换了原来的分支和撤回路径）；`registry-module-mock.ts` 的注释与成员；`registry.ts` 只改了 `uninstallPackage` 的文档注释。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/package-refused-first-install-over-tenant.test.ts src/package-refused-registration-withdrawn.test.ts`，预期 7 + 24 passed。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **A refused first install leaves nothing of itself, in every case.** When `ObjectQL.registerApp` registers a package id for the first time and the registry refuses it part-way, no package record, object, extension, app, item, picklist extension, namespace, navigation contribution, contributed kind or datasource definition of the package remains. This now also holds when the package layers over an object a tenant already holds (with or without the tenant's overlay layer), over an overlay with no owner, or over another package's extension of one of its objects. What was there reads exactly as before: who holds each layer, how it is classified, its priority, its body, and the object as served.
- **One mechanism.** Every registration body now runs through the registry's existing `SchemaRegistry.restoringOnRefusal`, the restore a refused upgrade already uses. The engine's separate uninstall-based withdrawal of a refused first install, and the check that decided whether it was safe, are removed: the restore covers every case the withdrawal did, and the cases it could not take.
- **Unchanged:** what is refused and every refusal's code, status and words; a clean install, a clean upgrade and a refused upgrade; an operator's uninstall; a persisted "disabled" state for the id still applies to its next install. `SchemaRegistry.uninstallPackage`'s `keepBootSeed` option stays available and unchanged; only its doc comment changes, since the engine no longer calls it for a refused install.
- The shared registry test double's comment now says what `registerApp` reads from it; one member nothing reads any more is dropped from it.
- Changeset: `patch` for `@objectstack/objectql`. It carries a sentence superseding the pending changeset line that said the engine passes `keepBootSeed` when it withdraws a refused first install.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-refused-first-install-over-tenant.test.ts` (new, 7 tests). Refused first installs of a package that layers over a tenant's object (with or without the tenant's overlay), over an overlay with no owner, or over another package's extension. Each asserts the same code and status, that nothing of the package remains, and that the existing object reads exactly as before the attempt. A fifth case keeps the boot seed of disabled packages. Controls: a clean first install over a tenant's object takes ownership with the tenant's layer as its overlay, as before; an operator's uninstall of it still removes the package.
- `package-refused-registration-withdrawn.test.ts`: the control for a body that took over a tenant's object now asserts the behaviour (nothing of the package, the tenant's object owned and served as before). Every other case in the file is unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- Through the HTTP doors, the tenant case is pinned at the unit layer only; the existing install-local dogfood file (first installs and upgrades refused part-way) runs green on this engine.
- Reading every open PR touching `objectql/src/engine.ts` or `registry.ts` before opening this one: only #28811 touches `registry.ts` (the `extend` refusal block and a new removal verb), away from these hunks; `git merge-tree` against it and against `origin/main` is clean.

## Verification

- The new file on base: 5 failed, 2 passed. Each of the five passed its code-and-status assertion and failed at the package-state comparison; the two controls pass on base.
</details>

- New file 7/7; `package-refused-registration-withdrawn.test.ts` 24/24; `package-refused-upgrade-keeps-installed.test.ts` 13/13; `engine.test.ts` green (180 tests across these four files).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run`: 522 files, 10010 tests, all green (`VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck` included).
- Dogfood, with the `@objectstack/dogfood^...` closure built under the lock (objectql dist carrying the new call, the removed path's log line absent): `install-local-refused-package-leaves-nothing` 4/4.
</details>

Red: the five new cases, the flipped tenant control, and the five first-install registry cases of the withdrawal file, which this call now carries. The upgrade file stays 13/13.
</details>
